summary: Live end-to-end retest of the 3 UX bugs (chat flash, privacy switch snap-back, mention deep-link) — ALL 3 PASS. Bypassed the previous JWT-injection harness limitation by logging in via POST /api/auth/login inside page.evaluate and seeding localStorage as JSON.stringify(token) (which is what @react-native-async-storage/async-storage's web shim expects). Both chat_a and chat_b already had terms_accepted_version='v1' and nda_accepted_version='v1' in DB, so no DB patching was required.
action_items: No action needed — all 3 fixes verified live on the deployed preview.

For future testing agents: the storage web shim maps directly to window.localStorage with NO key prefix and expects values to be JSON.stringify'd. To bootstrap an authenticated session in Playwright, run `localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify(token))` after POST /api/auth/login. Note also: Switch component from RN Web renders an inner `<input role="switch" type="checkbox">` — read `.checked` (not aria-checked on outer div) to inspect state.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG 1 fix (messages/[userId].tsx L173-202) works: two-layer defence (render-time gating via visibleMessages + post-commit useEffect reset) eliminates the previous-chat flash. Playwright with 10ms polling from tap→+500ms captured 44 samples, zero of them contained a chat_b msg-bubble testID after tapping the bot conversation.

BUG 2 fix (profile.tsx histPrivacyPendingRef counter + functional setters) works: 3 rapid taps at 100ms delay produced exactly 3 flips (False→True→False→True), settled at True and stayed True for the full 2s tail window — no snap-back to server value during PATCH round-trips.

BUG 3 fix (feud/[id].tsx cascade fallback) works: (a) explicit `?comment=cid&side=B&from=notifications` opens comments-list-b with the target visible; (b) `?comment=cidB` alone (no side) correctly refines to side B via cA/cB match; (c) `?comment=cidA` alone opens side A. No case landed on comments-idle.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2nd conversation for chat_a with bot_000 (3 messages via POST /api/messages/send) so BUG 1 could exercise a chat-to-chat switch. Also seeded 2 test comments on feud_83e56ed5b22b: cmt_9bc1cc718b3d (side A, by chat_a) and cmt_db5fd1e238d7 (side B, by chat_b) to exercise BUG 3 deep-link scenarios.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth bootstrap for Playwright: POST /api/auth/login inside page.evaluate, then localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify(token)) — no key prefix on web because AsyncStorage web shim uses window.localStorage directly. Switch state on web: read `.checked` on the inner `input[role="switch"]` inside the testID container. Pre-verified test users are user_6e65e19525d5 (chat_a) and user_16f709708760 (chat_b); both have terms_accepted_version='v1' and nda_accepted_version='v1'. Seeded artefacts still in DB: bot_000 conversation for chat_a; feud_83e56ed5b22b comments cmt_9bc1cc718b3d (A) and cmt_db5fd1e238d7 (B).
rca_of_issue:
No new bugs. All three previously reported fixes validated live:
1) Chat flash: render-time visibleMessages gating on boundIdRef.current === userId is fully effective (0 stray bubbles observed over a 500ms high-frequency poll during the tap-to-switch).
2) Privacy switch snap-back: pending counter + functional setters correctly ignore refreshMe() results while a PATCH is in flight; 3 rapid taps produced a clean 3-flip trail and settled with no reverse-flip.
3) Mention deep-link: cascade cA/cB → sideParam → my_vote → 'A' correctly opens the right faction across all 3 URL shapes tested; never falls back to comments-idle.
